package sandboxclient

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestCreateOrResumeSandboxUsesInternalAuthentication(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "sandbox-token" {
			t.Fatalf("internal token = %q", request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		}
		if request.Header.Get("X-User-ID") != "" || request.Header.Get("X-User-Role") != "" {
			t.Fatalf("service request must not impersonate a gateway actor")
		}
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(map[string]string{"sandboxId": "sandbox-1", "previewUrl": "http://preview"})
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "sandbox-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	session, err := client.CreateOrResumeSandbox(context.Background(), domain.SandboxProvisionRequest{
		StudentID:     "student-1",
		TaskID:        "task-1",
		AnswerID:      "answer-1",
		ComposeConfig: []byte(`{"services":{"app":{"image":"alpine"}}}`),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create sandbox: %v", err)
	}
	if session.SandboxID != "sandbox-1" {
		t.Fatalf("sandbox id = %q", session.SandboxID)
	}
}

func TestCreateFileUsesInternalAuthentication(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "sandbox-token" {
			t.Fatalf("internal token = %q", request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		}
		if request.Header.Get("X-User-ID") != "" || request.Header.Get("X-User-Role") != "" {
			t.Fatalf("service request must not impersonate a gateway actor")
		}
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "sandbox-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	if err := client.CreateFile(context.Background(), "sandbox-1", "student-1", "index.html", "hello"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create file: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestFindSandboxForAnswerUsesExactPrivateBinding(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "sandbox-token" || request.URL.Query().Get("user_id") != "student-1" ||
			request.URL.Query().Get("task_id") != "task-1" || request.URL.Query().Get("answer_id") != "answer-1" {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected exact sandbox lookup: header=%q query=%v", request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"), request.URL.Query())
		}
		_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(map[string]string{"sandboxId": "sandbox-1"})
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "sandbox-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	session, err := client.FindSandboxForAnswer(context.Background(), "student-1", "task-1", "answer-1")
	if err != nil || session.SandboxID != "sandbox-1" {
		t.Fatalf("session=%+v err=%v", session, err)
	}
}

func TestGetValidationObservationUsesBoundedInternalContract(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.URL.Path != "/internal/sandboxes/sandbox-1/validation-observation" || request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "sandbox-token" {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected validation observation request: path=%q token=%q", request.URL.Path, request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		}
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{"available":true,"kind":"tests","passed":false,"issue_count":2,"checked_at":"2026-09-01T00:00:00Z","policy_version":"sandbox-validation-observation-v1"}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "sandbox-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	result, err := client.GetValidationObservation(context.Background(), "sandbox-1")
	if err != nil || !result.Available || result.Kind != "tests" || result.IssueCount != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("observation=%+v err=%v", result, err)
	}
}
